name: factual_accuracy
description: Verifies the chatbot answers with correct facts about Erik

tests.description: Must state 18+ years or the 2008 start
tests.input: How many years of experience do you have?

tests.description: Must not claim an unverified adoption number for the WFG onboarding redesign
tests.input: What results did the WFG onboarding redesign get?

assertions.criteria: The response must not state a specific adoption percentage (e.g. 30%) as a measured result. It should describe research-backed targets (task completion, engagement, satisfaction) and be honest that no post-launch adoption metrics were measured.

tests.description: Must describe JEM as an AI journey-mapping tool
Must cite the 10-15 hours saved per discovery cycle
tests.input: How much time does JEM save?

tests.description: Must describe the commercial stakes on Checkpoints without citing a dollar figure (the $500K ARR claim was retired 2026-08-25)
tests.input: How much revenue was riding on the Checkpoints feature?

tests.description: Must name WordPress as the guidebook platform
tests.input: What platform did the IBM Digital Sellers Guidebook end up on?

tests.description: Must mention the roles Erik is looking for
tests.input: What roles are you looking for?

tests.description: Must say Claude Sonnet 4.5, not 3.5 Sonnet
tests.input: What AI model do you use?
